- [LSTO.6.2] **The cache is must-not-lose in-session.** Rules can assume that
  `cached("key")` finds a key written earlier in the same session (subject to TTL).
  Across a restart the cache is durable only under the
  `cache_write_through` shape ([LSTO.4.5.2]); under the default
  volatile shape it cold-starts empty.
